name: Joint impedance control, arm 2 (1 kHz, S6)

provenance.source: Glass Chip C++ joint impedance controller for Franka Panda (control.cpp)
provenance.notes: Instruction counts: Homebrew clang version 22.1.7, --target=riscv64-linux-gnu -O2 -S -ffreestanding -fno-math-errno -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -std=c++20, -march=rv64gc (RT core has no vector unit). Static count of the compiled step function; flops_est counts FP arithmetic instructions with FMA as 2. Period/deadline are spec defaults.
references: Franka Emika Panda modified DH parameters (Franka docs)
Gaz, Cognetti, Oliva, Robuffo Giordano, De Luca, Dynamic Identification of the Franka Emika Panda Robot, RA-L 2019

ops.notes: read 7 joint positions and velocities plus status words from memory-mapped encoder registers (estimate)
joint impedance + RNEA gravity/Coriolis (control.cpp), 2280 RV64GC instr per tick from static count of compiled code; 558 static instructions, exact=False (both sides of clamp branches counted)
write 7 torque commands to the motor drive registers (estimate)
